scope: Four correctness findings and three optimization opportunities from the follow-up review. Custom-element lifecycle and known preexisting form/template ownership limitations remain excluded.

fixes.finding: cssText corrupts semicolons inside CSS values
fixes.resolution: Share a quote-, escape- and delimiter-aware declaration scanner between inline CSSOM and computed-style parsing.
tests: Escaped quote/semicolon tokens and nested functions/brackets/braces

fixes.finding: Typed event initialization assigns to getter-only defaultPrevented
fixes.resolution: Read only declared typed-event dictionary fields, including inherited UI/mouse/modifier fields; ignore unknown/output-only Event members.
tests: All 11 typed event constructors ignore unknown getter properties without reading them
Existing derived MessageEvent readonly getter regression still passes

fixes.resolution: Retain one lazy registered wrapper for each message event property; update its callback without re-registering. Null assignment removes the wrapper.

fixes.finding: Discarded srcdoc windows receive queued messages
fixes.resolution: Verify the cached frame entry and current srcdoc remain active, in addition to existing parent generation/document/connectivity guards. Nested frames inherit the same liveness guard.
tests: Discarded child and descendant messages are dropped
Current replacement child still receives messages
Changing srcdoc invalidates delivery even before reading the replacement contentWindow

optimizations.change: Cache parsed/serialized inline styles by their raw attribute string
optimizations.invalidation: Every read compares the current raw attribute; CSSOM writes update the cached parsed state and serialization. Regression tests cover direct attributes, CSSOM writes/removal, priorities, and removal of the whole attribute.

optimizations.change: Allocate the iframe WeakMap only when contentWindow is first requested
optimizations.measurement: Removes one eager allocation per environment without frames; no isolated throughput claim.
Parsed inflation and deep cloning can install their existing fragment without first allocating a fragment that is immediately discarded; no isolated throughput claim.

style_read_microbenchmark.statistic: Median milliseconds; lower is better. Same fixed five-declaration element; no mutations.
style_read_microbenchmark.limits: Repeated-read microbenchmark only; not an end-to-end Wistia runtime estimate. Shared machine load varied between runs.

query_smoke.limits: Ran while the Wistia integration sample was active. Smoke check only; do not compare absolute values to a quiet benchmark or replace the published query snapshot.

wistia_integration: Root agent is running the same 63-file frontend sample (original 56 plus seven follow-up regression files); results will be recorded separately after completion.
